// A file that breaks both source rules, in every spelling the reader claims to
// see. It is read as a fixture and never built, so its import paths and its
// arithmetic do not have to make sense together.

package kernel

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
)

// Prints five ways.
func report(total float64) {
	fmt.Print("the total is ")
	fmt.Printf("%v\n", total)
	fmt.Println(total)
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, total)
	println(total)
}

// Computes a decibel arithmetic four ways, which is what belongs in one place.
func combine(a, b float64) float64 {
	ea := math.Pow(10, a/10)
	eb := math.Exp(b / 10)
	total := 10 * math.Log10(ea+eb)
	return total + math.Log(2)
}
